Generational generosity fr 😭

“Lifestyle” by Rich Gang, featuring Young Thug and Rich Homie Quan, is one of the defining trap records of the 2010s. Released in 2014, the track was driven by London on da Track’s melodic, piano-heavy production and became a major commercial success.

The song is especially remembered for the unique chemistry between Young Thug and Rich Homie Quan. Thug’s eccentric opening delivery immediately grabs attention, while Quan’s soulful vocals and memorable hook give the track its emotional core. Their back-and-forth helped define the melodic trap sound of that era.

The lavish music video, featuring a private jet and yacht, perfectly matched the song’s larger-than-life energy. Years later, “Lifestyle” remains a nostalgic snapshot of the Rich Gang era and a fan-favorite reminder of the chemistry between two unforgettable Atlanta voices.
